overview.text: 不 means “not” and is attested as a negative particle in oracle-bone inscriptions. Its original pictured subject remains disputed; a proposed sound-based borrowing is unverified.

components.text: Treat 不 as one whole picture. Proposed subjects include roots, a flower calyx, or Shuowen’s bird; another proposal links a 戈-related tassel to a tassel word, but its graph is unclear.
